name: Overall job-market opportunity
primary_source: International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) — ILOSTAT bulk download
recommendation: Proceed to a deterministic Phase 5E probe. The measured 88/91 intersection clears the 82-country threshold but requires an explicit missing-country policy.

name: Skilled-work visa accessibility
recommendation: Defer to a future profile/legal-mobility layer. Reject it as an independent destination criterion.

name: Permanent-residency accessibility
recommendation: Defer to a route-aware profile layer; reject a single national accessibility score.

name: Average earning potential
observation_type: National survey/administrative estimates, harmonised by ILOSTAT
primary_source: International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) — ILOSTAT bulk download
recommendation: Defer. Measured recent PPP earnings coverage is 60/91 for 2023+ and 76/91 for 2021+, below the Phase 5A threshold.

name: Personal income-tax burden
primary_source: OECD — Taxing Wages 2026 / OECD Data Explorer
recommendation: Defer to a profile-based affordability calculator; do not use the OECD-only series as a 91-country ranking criterion.

name: Housing affordability
observation_type: City/regional market data plus household income scenario
recommendation: Defer to the city and profile layers. National OECD ratios are useful validation data, not the independent criterion.

name: Healthcare system capacity and quality
observation_type: National composite using reported and modelled tracer indicators
primary_source: World Bank (distribution) / WHO (upstream) — Health Nutrition and Population Statistics
recommendation: Defer now. The reusable World Bank representation is complete but remains at 2021; the fresh 2023 WHO release has unresolved commercial reuse for direct ingestion.

name: English usability
primary_source: EF Education First — EF English Proficiency Index 2025
recommendation: Defer to a city/preference layer. Do not use EF EPI as a production country criterion.

name: Overall higher-education opportunity
primary_source: World Bank (distribution) / UNESCO UIS (upstream) — World Development Indicators
recommendation: Experimental/recovery probe only. Overall coverage is 88/91, but only 77/91 have 2023+ data and 81/91 have 2021+ data.

name: Existing immigrant share
observation_type: National stock estimate from censuses, registers, surveys and imputation
primary_source: World Bank (distribution) / UN Population Division (upstream) — World Development Indicators
recommendation: Proceed to deterministic Phase 5E probe; measured current coverage is 91/91.

name: Software and technology jobs
primary_source: International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT) — ILOSTAT bulk download
recommendation: Defer to a city/occupation layer. Recent two-digit occupation data cover only 66/91 and remain semantically too broad.

name: Internet access, speed, and reliability
primary_source: World Bank (distribution) / ITU (upstream) — World Development Indicators
recommendation: Experimental/redundancy probe only for a narrowed access-and-penetration criterion. Do not claim speed or reliability.

name: Electricity access and reliability
observation_type: National access estimate plus firm-survey outage data
primary_source: World Bank / WHO-UNICEF tracking partners — World Development Indicators
recommendation: Defer. Access measured 91/91 for 2024, but the WDI API returned no observations for IC.ELC.OUTG; access alone does not answer reliability.

name: School education quality
observation_type: National composite/modelled harmonisation of assessments and schooling
primary_source: World Bank — Human Capital Index Plus
recommendation: Proceed to deterministic Phase 5E probe; measured field coverage is 89/91 and the source is current, official and reusable.

name: Extreme-weather risk
primary_source: European Commission JRC / INFORM partners — INFORM Risk Index 2026
series_or_table: INFORM_Risk_2026_v072.xlsx: River Flood, Tropical Cyclone, Coastal flood, Drought
recommendation: Experimental Phase 5E probe only. Coverage is complete, but a Konsider-specific weather subset and weighting need defensibility testing.
